excluded.gitlinks: Gitlinks are recorded in repositories and their tracked files are collected recursively.
excluded.ignored_untracked: Git-ignored untracked files are excluded. Runtime-required source must be explicitly tracked.
excluded.lfs_payloads: LFS payload bytes are not source hashes; index pointer identity is recorded in lfs_pointers.
excluded.manifest_reason: The manifest does not hash itself; no current root HEAD or timestamps are recorded.
